scripts.title: The Grand Continental
scripts.rawText:
[INTENT]
Create a dry, deadpan 1850s European indie buddy-comedy montage teaser featuring @image1 as Rosa, @image2 as Evan, and @image3 as Fiona as three inept petty thieves stumbling through a chaotic cross-border caper.

[LOGIC]
Treat each montage cut as an independent in-media-res moment with no inherited posture across location jumps, while preserving strict left-to-right eyeline geometry and exact hand-prop allocation within each shot. Keep character movements grounded, physical, and reactive whenever off-screen dialogue occurs. No subtitles appear on screen.

[AESTHETIC]
Medium: 35mm film, fine grain, crisp symmetrical framing, flat-field vintage anamorphic glass
Palette: pastel mustard, dusty rose, sage green, warm cream, muted slate
Lighting: soft overcast daylight, warm brass practicals inside carriages, even pastel fill
Location: Sunlit cobblestone Viennese bakery alley with ochre plaster walls and wooden bread crates -> LOC01; Symmetrical 1850s Prussian railway carriage interior with sage velvet benches and brass luggage racks -> LOC02; Muddy Bavarian manor courtyard with wrought-iron gates, stone fountain, and boxwood hedges -> LOC03
Wardrobe: Rosa in a mustard wool waist-jacket, cream linen blouse, olive skirt, and laced leather boots -> RS01; Rosa in a dusty-rose frock coat, striped waistcoat, brown wool trousers, and riding boots -> RS02; Evan in a sage tweed tailcoat, burgundy cravat, tan breeches, and mud-spattered gaiters -> EV01; Evan in a cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal vest, suspenders, and black boots -> EV02; Fiona in a burgundy velvet capelet, high-collar lace blouse, slate-blue skirt, and buttoned ankle boots -> FN01; Fiona in a tan oilskin trench, tweed flat cap, plaid wool trousers, and hobnail boots -> FN02
Audio: distant horse hooves on cobbles, rhythmic iron rail clatter, faint wind

[OPENING]
Symmetrical MS at eye level inside LOC01. Frame-left, Rosa in RS01 crouches behind wooden bread crates facing screen-right, clutching a canvas satchel in her left hand. Frame-right, Evan in EV01 presses his back against the ochre wall facing screen-left, holding a stolen brass bell in his right hand.

[EXECUTION]
[CAM] MS, eye-level at LOC01 -> [ACT] Rosa in RS01 peeks over the crates with her satchel in her left hand while Evan in EV01 ducks lower, shoving the brass bell under his coat with his right hand -> Rosa says (V.O., deadpan) {Rule one of theft: never steal before breakfast.} -> [ACT] Evan in EV01 winces as a crate tips
[CAM] MCU, eye-level at LOC02 -> [ACT] Fiona in FN01 sits frame-center facing screen-left, snapping a silver pocket watch shut with her right thumb as the carriage jolts her shoulders -> Rosa says (V.O., dry) {Rule two: never trust Evan with the map.} -> [ACT] Fiona in FN01 tucks the watch into her capelet and straightens her collar
[CAM] WS, low-angle tracking at LOC03 -> [ACT] Evan in EV02 sprints frame-left to frame-right through ankle-deep mud, cradling a heavy silver candelabra in both hands while kicking up wet clods -> <wet boots churning mud> -> Rosa says (V.O., brisk) {And rule three: run faster than the aristocracy.} -> [ACT] Evan in EV02 nearly slips, recovering his stride
[CAM] CU, eye-level at LOC01 -> [ACT] Rosa in RS01, frame-left facing screen-right, widens her eyes and shoves a warm loaf into her satchel with her left hand while chewing frantically -> Evan says (O.S., panicked) {They have pitchforks!} -> [ACT] Rosa in RS01 swallows hard and bolts toward screen-right
[CAM] MS, Dutch angle at LOC02 -> [ACT] Evan in EV01 stands frame-right facing screen-left, bracing both palms against the swaying brass rack as his knees buckle -> Fiona says (O.S., flat) {You dropped the ransom note, didn't you?} -> [ACT] Evan in EV01 grimaces, pats his empty coat pockets with his right hand, and nods stiffly
[CAM] CU, eye-level at LOC03 -> [ACT] Fiona in FN02 stands frame-center facing screen-left, blinking slowly while wiping a streak of mud off her cheek with her left sleeve -> Rosa says (O.S., breathless) {Fiona, the gate is locked!} -> [ACT] Fiona in FN02 sighs through her nose and unhooks a crowbar from her belt with her right hand
[CAM] WS, low-angle at LOC03 -> [ACT] Rosa in RS02, Evan in EV02, and Fiona in FN02 charge from background to foreground and vault simultaneously over the boxwood hedge, coattails snapping in mid-air -> <snapping twigs and heavy boot thuds>
[CAM] MS, eye-level at LOC01 -> [ACT] Evan in EV02 leans frame-right facing screen-left against the alley wall, chest heaving, clutching the brass bell in both hands with a sheepish grin -> Fiona says (O.S., exhausted) {Tell me that's solid gold.} -> [ACT] Evan in EV02 taps the bell with his knuckle, producing a dull tin clank -> <hollow tin clank>
[CAM] Static ECU at LOC02 -> [ACT] Warm sunlight illuminates a gilded, hand-painted 1850s parchment title card pinned to the sage velvet seat -> 【THE GRAND CONTINENTAL】 -> [ACT] Hand-drawn ink flourishes curl outward around the serif lettering while a tiny wax seal stamps the bottom corner -> <crisp wax-seal thud>
